messages:
Elena (mktg ops): Putting together Friday's KPI slate — noticing launch-post impressions are healthy but demo conversions not following. Can someone sanity-check source splits?
Jonas (analytics): Pulled quick table: social paid surge 3/15-3/18, webinar nurture 3/12-3/14. Social shows high clicks but lower demo CR vs webinar.
Priya (demand): What's the attribution window here? Benchmarks used 14d first-touch, dashboard is 30d last-touch. That could be why numbers look off.
Marco (growth): Also, session playbacks suggest people expect feature examples on pricing and aren't finding them. Messaging mismatch + long path to demo could explain the delta.
Elena (mktg ops): Small SQL I used to validate: ```SELECT source, count(distinct user_id) as users, sum(is_demo) as demos FROM events WHERE event_date BETWEEN '2026-03-10' AND '2026-03-20' GROUP BY 1```
Jonas (analytics): I'll add a 7/14/30 toggle to the dashboard and include first-touch vs last-touch columns + sample sizes so leadership isn't confused by volatile small cohorts.
Priya (demand): Can we also surface HubSpot vs SFDC demo counts on the slide? We had a webhook drop earlier this month that undercounted a chunk of demo requests.
Marco (growth): Proposal: quick creative swap on pricing CTA for traffic tagged from the launch post and webinar drip. If CTR lifts but demo pipeline still low, that's a sign of CRM ingestion problem.
Elena (mktg ops): Action items: Jonas 1 dashboard toggles + dual-source counts; Priya 1 check HubSpot->SFDC mapping and post results; Marco 1 draft two CTA variants for rapid test.
ops-bot: "ops-bot: Weekly KPI sync Friday 10:00am 1 invite posted to #marketing."
Jonas (analytics): ETA: viz changes by EOD, will upload sample-size table.
Priya (demand): Mapping audit by tomorrow noon.
Marco (growth): CTA variants live tomorrow AM, measure 72h.
Elena (mktg ops): For the KPI slide please include a one-paragraph note on attribution windows and a small appendix with time-to-convert deciles. Thanks all. :rocket:
